structured.answer: I'm not deciding anything. I'll ask you (my son) and the bank. Harel's page only shows "קופת גמל להשקעה" tracks, which are mostly shares, with a fee of about half a percent (0.54%–0.61% of the savings). The only one that sounded safe, "כספי (שקלי)", shows 4.25% over 3 years, but I don't know what's inside it.
